# msr

## Description



Read or write to Model Specifc Register (MSR)

## Usage:


```bash
usage: msr [-h] [-w [write_value]] [-l] [-r [MSR_RANGE]] [msr]

```
## Positional Arguments

|Positional Argument|Help|
| :--- | :--- |
|`msr`|MSR value or name|

## Optional Arguments

|Short|Long|Default|Help|
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
|`-h`|`--help`||show this help message and exit|
|`-w`|`--write`|`None`|value to write in MSR|
|`-l`|`--list`||list common MSRs for the current arch (default: %(default)s)|
|`-r`|`--range`|`None`|dash separated range of MSRs to read (eg. --range=1-10 where 10 is included)|
